items.q: But after -- I mean, when you began, the sort of jazz conception was sort of -- I guess you might say more or less like Kid Ory plays.

ctx.x: But after -- I mean, when you began, the sort of jazz conception was sort of -- I guess you might say more or less like Kid Ory plays. Now, the next step would be Jimmy Harrison and Jack Teagarden?
Yeah. Jack Teagarden, he used the plunger sometime, but he was an open horn man.
